**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear, concise description of what the problem is — e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear, concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Does this touch either of the project's hard constraints?**
This app never renders human faces in icons/illustrations, and never uses actual Ayat/Mushaf text as decoration (see [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md)). If your idea is visual, note how it respects these.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or references here.
